external_games.name: Flappy Coq - The 2D Rooster Simulator Game

name: Flappy Coq
storyline:
Root hens 'n stay alive!

Flappy Coq is a 2D rooster simulator where the goal is to root as many hens as possible. Defend against your arch enemies - the fox, the eagle and the Hillbilly Neighbor to earn extra lives and root more hens!

A hilarious adventure complete with bluegrass rooster themed soundtrack.
summary: A fast, comedic 2D arcade flyer where you flap a stubborn rooster through deadly gaps, chase high scores, and purchase skins. Tight controls, snappy retries, global leaderboards, and escalating obstacles keep every run tense, hilarious, and endlessly re-playable.
